messages.author: c5f646719e8ab61c
messages.subject: Ghost values when using geom_density
parts:
Dear all,

I'm struggling with what is probably a very simple problem. When
trying to plot the density of some data (for example as in
http://dl.dropbox.com/u/2414056/test.Rdata) using

ggplot(a, aes(test)) + geom_density()

I get a nice harmonic depiction of my data, but with intermediate
values, which are not real (as everything is integer).

Is there a way to force ggplot to only plot at the integer values?

Many thanks,

Ingo

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Ghost values when using geom_density
parts:
Hi Ingo, by definition a density plot is continuous. Maybe you want to
use geom_histogram instead?
Ben

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Ghost values when using geom_density
parts:
Check out stat_bin. Basically, for a data frame d with column x, you
want something like

ggplot(d,aes(x=x)) + stat_bin(aes(y=..count..),geom="line")

Another option would be to pre-bin using R's hist command.

Ben
